category: Things nobody tells you about adulthood
quote: Nobody told you that being an adult is just managing your own chores. You spend all week looking forward to doing absolutely nothing on Saturday. The laundry pile is now a sentient roommate that refuses to move. Your biggest thrill is finding a brand of trash bags that actually fits. We just spent twenty years trying to grow up for this exact experience.
